title: Jing Ye, the Outlaw (亡命徒 荆野) - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Jing Ye, the Outlaw (亡命徒 荆野) in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: Jing Ye, the Outlaw (亡命徒 荆野) phantom blade zero boss

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Jing Ye, the Outlaw (亡命徒 荆野) is a story encounter in Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest, found at Crimson Forest. Beating it yields Outlaw Warblade.

sections.title: Where to Find the Jing Ye, the Outlaw (亡命徒 荆野)
sections.content:
Location: Crimson Forest.

Appears in: Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is mandatory, so it cannot be walked past - the fight is worth learning rather than trying to out-level.

sections.title: How to Beat the Jing Ye, the Outlaw (亡命徒 荆野)
sections.content:
What works

  • Dodge the mounted charges rather than trying to block them, and punish between attack sequences.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 11 of 60 in the progression order, in Crimson Manor & Crimson Forest. Before it: Hua Qianxiao, the Sword Fanatic (剑痴 花千笑). After it: Stone Hand Iron Fever (拳痴 铁狂). The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
